description: A script for managing the startup procedure in a build/development environment, particularly handling CI detection, environment sanitation, and conditional server start commands.

methods.name: isCI
methods.description: Detects whether the current environment is a Continuous Integration (CI) environment based on environment variables.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a command synchronously with specified arguments, inheriting stdio and environment variables, then exits the process with the command's exit code.
